about_the_game:
Game Introduction

Cat Familiar Center is a relaxed and enjoyable cat-raising game. Players take on the role of a witch, who, with the help of her witch companions, cultivates various cat familiars with different appearances and personalities, all according to your design. You'll also assist those in need of a familiar by helping them find the perfect cat familiar.

Background Story

After long preparations, your Cat Familiar Center is finally ready to open! In this magical world, there are many different races and types of familiars. However, only witches possess the knowledge and ability to create and cultivate cat familiars. In response to urgent requests, you decide to cultivate the perfect cat familiars to allow more people to own their very own magical companions.

Gameplay

  • Summoning and Creation:
    Cat familiars possess a genetic pool and breed types similar to real cats, but with magical features like wings and halos—things real cats don't have. All of this follows the laws of genetics.
    Through the witch's magic, you can combine the genes of any two cat familiars to create a new kitten! During this process, no harm will come to the cat familiars, thanks to the magic.

    The game operates on real-time; each time a new cat familiar is summoned, it takes a different amount of real-world time to complete depending on the difficulty of the spell.

  • Bonding and Commissioning:
    Most of the created cat familiars won't stay at the center permanently. They will either be sent to new homes through bonding, or you will receive commissions from dragons, elves, unknown lifeforms, and other witches. These clients have specific requests, hoping you'll create a cat familiar that meets their requirements.
    Whether it's a successful bond or completing a commission, you'll receive generous rewards.

  • Personality Testing:
    In bonding and commissions, you might encounter requests from clients who want their cats to have specific personalities. This is where the personality testing comes in! A quiet witch friend will accompany you throughout the process.

  • Shop:
    You can also... adopt some adorable cat familiars from your witch friends!

Studio Introduction & Creative Origins

Hello! We are the Calico Studio, composed of two women and a cat!

For us, Cat Familiar Center began with a small curiosity. Our studio cat is a little white cat with a hint of light orange. So, is it a white cat or an orange-and-white cat? Why is the orange part so small? With this curiosity, we delved into the genetics of cats and their physical traits, becoming fascinated by the vast and interesting world of genetics.

Most pea-type games (a genre where characters breed and grow) feature human protagonists. So, we wanted to create a pea-style game, but with kittens as the focus.

To safely research the genetics of cat familiars, we knew magic was necessary! And witches, naturally, are the beings who have spent the most time alongside cats. To ensure every cat familiar's health and safety, we set the game in a fantasy world, hoping to present a unique relationship between witches and cats.

Thank you for your love and attention to Cat Familiar Center. We look forward to meeting you and your familiars in the game world!
